messages:
IncidentBot: ALERT: gateway-prod error rate spike detected. 5xx increased to ~12% starting 08:42 UTC. Spike correlated with scheduling backlog on batcher pools. Paging @Ben-prod-oncall. Dashboard: https://internal-redwood/dashboards/5xx-spike

DeployBot: Deploy note: scheduler-v2.1.3 rolled to prod 08:40 UTC to batcher-autoscale. No automatic rollback.

Sasha: Oncall Sasha - ack. I'm taking lead for triage. First glance: batcher-pool-3 queue depth at 93%, inflight token counts rising, prefix KV growth on nodes p3-7. Gateway timeouts and 502s look like requests getting stuck waiting for batch window.

Omar: I see the same. Traces show many requests waiting 200-400ms in scheduler queue before tokenization, then timeouts at gateway. Sample trace ids: trace:ab12, trace:cd34 - both show scheduling wait > 700ms. CPU on scheduler nodes is OK, but batch build latency is skyrocketing.

Anya: Can we temporarily reduce max_batch_size and shorten batch wait? Suggest batching.max_batch_tokens 512 -> 256 and max_wait_ms 50 -> 30. That should reduce HOL blocking. Anyone want to apply as hotfix?

Sasha: Good call. Applying change to batch-config in config-store for batcher-pool-3. Command I ran:
```
kubectl -n infra exec config-store -- curl -X POST \ 
  -d '{"batching.max_batch_tokens":256,"batching.max_wait_ms":30}' \ 
  http://config-store.internal/v1/reload
```

Sasha: Pushed change at 08:50 UTC. Also triggering a soft-preempt on long-wait requests: running eviction script to drop oldest low-priority queued requests from pool-3.

Omar: Running eviction script now on pool-3. Script:
```
./tools/evict_queue.py --pool pool-3 --policy drop-oldest --limit 500
```

Omar: Eviction completed 08:52 UTC. Queue depth fell from 93% -> 48% on pool-3. Immediate effect: gateway 5xx rate down to ~4.5% in the last 2m. Latency p95 moved from 1.8s -> 900ms.

Ben: Ben (prod-oncall) here - taking incident. Thanks Sasha and Omar. I'll stay on shift. Handing over to me for next 30m.

Sasha: Leaving a note: we also temporarily split traffic to fallback-model-small for non-enterprise customers to reduce load on heavy model instances. Traffic split command:
```
POST /control/routing/split
body: {"route":"text-gen","split": [{"target":"fallback-small","pct":30},{"target":"primary","pct":70}]}
```

Anya: Observability: added a dashboard panel for queue wait histogram and batch size distribution. Also set alert mute for noisy false positives.

Omar: Confirming metrics: error rate trending down to 2.2% after 2m, gateway timeouts dropping. No customer-facing outage detected yet, but some requests were 504 earlier. Customer-impact check: top 3 accounts saw increased error percentage but no mass outage. CS notified.

Sasha: Note for runbook: cause appears to be combinatorial of scheduler config from v2.1.3 plus a burst of long requests causing batching windows to exceed target latency and HOL buildup. Mitigation sequence that worked: reduce max_batch_tokens, shorten max_wait_ms, evict oldest low-priority queued requests, split traffic to smaller model variant.

Ben: Next steps I'm executing: keep traffic split for 15m, monitor p95 gateway latency and 5xx. If stable at <1.5% 5xx and p95 <1s, roll forward change to other pools. If reversion needed, we have previous config snapshot at config-store:/snapshots/2026-03-15/08:35.

Sasha: I'm going to create a short incident report and tag eng-runtime and eng-ml. Leaving runbook entries and the commands used in the thread. I'll also attach a short list of diffed configs.

DeployBot: Note: scheduler patch v2.1.3 flagged as suspect. Open ticket created: INT-7123. Link: https://tickets/redwood/INT-7123

Ben: Handoff complete at 09:05 UTC. I'll keep this thread updated every 10 min until stable. Current status: 5xx down to 1.3%, p95 720ms, queue depths healthy. :thumbsup:

Sasha: Thanks all. Action items for postmortem: 1) Add autoscaling guard to prevent batch window runaway 2) Add circuit breaker on queue-length per pool 3) Postmortem with eng-runtime and ML model owners to evaluate model cost/latency tradeoffs 4) Update runbook with exact eviction commands.

Anya: I'll own the circuit breaker task. Omar will follow up on eviction tool improvements.

Ben: Closing active paging. Will re-open if regression. Marking status: mitigated, monitoring.

IncidentBot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> monitoring. Root cause suspected scheduler config change interacting with burst of long-duration requests. Postmortem required.
summary: Batch scheduler backlog caused gateway 5xx/timeouts by inducing head-of-line waiting. Team mitigated via smaller batches, shorter wait windows, evicting low-priority queued requests, and splitting traffic to a lighter model. Handoff to prod-oncall, monitoring in progress.
